Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API integration - request for technical deep-dive

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — MedBridge's Platform team would like a technical deep-dive focused on the Hosted API integration surface. We're specifically interested in: SDK usage patterns, streaming best practices for long form transcripts (~10-12k tokens), function/tool-calling for our workflow engine, and auth/session management in a multi-tenant setup.

Could we schedule a 60–75 minute session the week of June 14? Our engineers are available: Tue 6/15 10:00–12:00 PT, Wed 6/16 14:00–17:00 PT, or Thu 6/17 09:00–11:00 PT.

It would be helpful if you could share a short checklist of what we'll need on our side (sample prompts, token estimates, auth examples). Also, please flag any items that require Dedicated or Private deployment conversations (data residency/SSO).

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Senior Integration Lead | MedBridge Health
elena.ruiz@medbridgehealth.com

Attachment: "MedBridge-initial-requirements.xlsx" (spreadsheet, 24 KB)

- Who can lead the runtime/streaming section? Markus, you good to own kernel/latency/kv-cache discussion?
- Marissa, can you cover SDK patterns, sample snippets (Python/TS) and function-calling examples?
- Jonas, please prep a 5–10 minute bit about our rollout/compatibility approach (model variants, fallback policies).

Availability check: Elena suggested Tue 6/15 10–12 PT or Wed 6/16 14–17 PT. If we do 75 minutes, I propose 10:00–11:15 PT on 6/15 so we can keep late afternoon free for followups. If that doesn't work I'll propose Wed.

I'll draft a short checklist and attach it here for review (first pass). Please add any items you think MedBridge must prepare (API keys, sample prompt sets, long transcript examples).

Thanks — Tessa
